description.en: The ID of the image component to delete.

description.zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

descriptions.zh:
- 仅支持删除您已创建的自定义镜像组件。
- 当删除组件时，确保该组件不在模板中使用，否则将会删除失败。
descriptions.en:
- Only custom image components that you have created can be deleted.
- Before deleting a component, make sure that the component is not used in any template. Otherwise, the deletion fails.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs delete-image-component --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-component-id ic-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
